space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 5
space.notes: env_layout2 plus one waypoint, rest_0, for the end-state variant of scenario_20 (scenario_50, F47): after its last delivery the human walks to rest_0 and stays there instead of idling at the kitting table, so the robot's last table deliveries are not refused by the separation stop. rest_0 lies due east of the table (bearing 0 deg), >= 51 deg off every shelf bearing from the table (shelf_2 -51, shelf_7 -59, shelf_3 -107, shelf_4 -121, shelf_6 -128), so the walk to it fits no delivery hypothesis; type 'waypoint' is enumerated by no task, so it adds no hypothesis. Everything else is env_layout2 byte for byte. Layout2's notes apply.

env_objects.notes: Shared delivery sink. A candidate whose carry leg reaches the table while the human's projection is still running converges here, and its min_dist is set by the projected arrival-time gap (both placements coincide at this point when the gap is under a tick). Candidates arriving after the human's projection ends show no sink conflict. Current figures: analysis/t1_conflict_measurement/REPORT.md, TODO-28/TODO-30.

Robot's cheapest task (approach 447 + carry 583 cm ≈ 54 ticks at 20 cm/tick, incl. pick and place). Its conflict comes from the matched arrival time at the kitting table, not from the 150 cm adjacency to shelf_3; the adjacency makes item_4 an early IR decoy.
Human's first target. Human approach 449 vs robot 447 — time-aligned. With assignment_prior off, theta crosses at the human's grasp here (step 22).

Robot's clean alternative (approach 550 + carry 820 cm ≈ 71 ticks). Seen from the human's path it lies nearly behind shelf_3 (9–20° off heading), so it is the IR decoy that keeps confidence below theta until the grasp (TODO-38).
Robot's third task (approach 1151 + carry 875 cm ≈ 103 ticks). Far enough east that it never competes — present to keep the pool at three, matching scenario_00.
Human's second target. At -36.9 deg from the human's start it is angularly far from shelf_3/4/6, so it does not muddy the early ambiguity.
Robot task 2 — the clean alternative B2 can escalate to.

The human's end-state spot (scenario_50): scripted as coffee_break(rest_0) after its last delivery - the schema supplies the walk and the PT60S stand; the human then idles here. 470 cm east of the table's arrival point, off every robot route (T->shelf_7 leaves the table at -59 deg; the robot passes 340+ cm from here).
